audit.finding: quality endpoints acknowledge payload, but useful durable analytics was absent/incomplete
evidence: quality push handlers discarded payloads and returned AcceptedResponse(status=stored)
quality evaluation and issue-group read handlers always returned empty arrays
knowledge-worker had no quality persistence/evaluation loop
migrations 0001-0007 contained no quality analytics tables

idempotency_constraints: quality_cases.delivery_key primary key and turn_id+revision unique
quality_evaluations.evaluation_id primary key and turn_id+revision unique

schema_objects.quality_cases: pushed turn facts, opaque labels, evidence references, provenance and payload hash
schema_objects.quality_feedback: independent specialist/information-quality ratings, solved and comment
schema_objects.quality_evaluations: deterministic dimension records and separate critical_error
schema_objects.issue_groups: deterministic repeated-attribute read model with limitations/hypotheses

intake.turn: implemented in QualityRepository and InMemoryQualityStore; received_at, source_type, stable identity, payload hash and provenance persisted
intake.duplicate: same identity and same payload returns idempotent result
intake.conflict: turn/feedback same identity with different payload raises QualityPayloadConflict; completion accepts a strictly later adapter terminal fact and rejects stale/equal conflicting content
intake.raw_pii: only contract facts are retained; provenance allow-list excludes arbitrary headers

evaluator.evidence_rule: factual_support is UNKNOWN without evidence references; references produce a supported-reference score, not an entailment claim
evaluator.critical_error: separate boolean/reason populated from an explicitly supplied error_category

forbidden_inferences: information-quality feedback is not specialist fault
specialist rating does not prove resolution
comment does not prove a product defect

issue_groups.algorithm: deterministic grouping by supplied service_need, error_category, reason_codes or opaque decision label

examples.label: Repeated service_need: UPD status
examples.limitation: repeated supplied attributes are not proof of a product defect

employee_safety.specialist_slices: only supplied distributions/counts can be aggregated; no causal employee score

tests.real_postgres: skipped: AI4_TEST_DATABASE_URL not configured; no normal development DB was modified

limitations: Existing HTTP routes still acknowledge pushes and are intentionally not wired in AI-4; AI-5 must call QualityRepository and map conflicts/errors.
knowledge-worker scheduling and retry loop remain to be wired by AI-5.
Real PostgreSQL upgrade/downgrade and cross-session durability require an explicitly disposable AI4_TEST_DATABASE_URL.
The deterministic rubric cannot prove factual entailment without source text; it records this limitation rather than claiming correctness.
